rows.section: Multi-year advisory text under the Manage obligations page heading.
rows.english: Acquire and accept packaging waste recycling notes (PRNs) and packaging waste export recycling notes (PERNs) until your recycling obligations are fully met. Select a material for information on how the data was calculated and view your progress towards meeting your {0} recycling obligations.
rows.welsh: Ewch ati i gaffael a derbyn nodiadau ailgylchu gwastraff pecynwaith (PRNs) a nodiadau ailgylchu allforio gwastraff pecynwaith (PERNs) nes bod eich rhwymedigaethau ailgylchu wedi'u bodloni'n llawn. Dewiswch ddeunydd i gael gwybodaeth am sut y cyfrifwyd y data a gweld eich cynnydd tuag at fodloni’ch rhwymedigaethau ailgylchu {0}.
